A '''clone trooper pilot''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He participated in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] in which he piloted one of the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]] participating in the assault. The gunship, which was carrying [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] nicknamed "Cody". This pilot was able to land one of a handful of gunships at the [[Point Rain/Legends|Site]] under heavy fire.

==Biography==
This clone pilot was [[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="db" /> Serving under CC-2224 during his time on [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], he was assigned to bring a gunship carrying Cody and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] to a land site where they would later capture a droid base.<ref name="lapr" />

==Personality and traits==
Like his fellow clones, he stood 1.83 meters tall like his genetic template, Jango Fett.<ref name="db" />
